summaries.summary: PM Modi exchanged Diwali greetings with VP CP Radhakrishnan and emphasized celebrating the festival with soldiers.
Apple's rumored plan to remove the Action Button from future iPhone models suggests a major design change. Additionally, Apple has started delivering new iPad mini, MacBook Pros, and iMac.

Sequoia's decision to shut down its Scouts program indicates a shift in venture capital strategies, while Crusoe's sale of a troubled data center project to Google highlights challenges in the AI infrastructure space.
Abhishek Banerjee reported a seventh attempt on his life, claiming responsibility lies with BJP supporters amidst ongoing political tensions.
Trump confirmed US strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island as new tensions escalate, with military actions and diplomatic efforts unfolding simultaneously.
Incidents of violence were reported including an attack in Faridabad where an ex-Tech Mahindra head was shot dead over a parking dispute.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Delta Reign Expansion has been released, generating excitement among fans.
Hundreds of hacking tools were exposed online, raising security concerns in the tech community.
A video surfaced capturing a fight between passengers on a Mumbai local train, which culminated in one person falling off.
